description: Set up an EXISTING bare domain (example.com) that doesn't open the site (www works). Refuses if dotsy already serves it; deletes nothing. domain.dnsRecords: (1) _acme-challenge CNAME (apex_cert); (2) once issueState is issued, replace the old @ records (action delete) with the A/AAAA rows. cancel:true (while canCancelSetUp) restores everything; 409 too_late_to_stop once @ points at dotsy. Other 409: www_not_connected, already_serving, not_supported, not_needed. 503: retry.

cancel.description: Stop a set-up that has not gone live and restore the previous state exactly

name: set_up_bare_domain
